decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and using powerful support cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides extra flexibility and consistency to the deck. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and impactful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast and powerful threats, while also disrupting their game plan with its disruptive elements like Wasteland and Karakas.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Doomsday combo to win the game by playing Thassa's Oracle. It includes cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly, while also running disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The deck aims to assemble the combo pieces, resolve Doomsday, and use Thassa's Oracle to win the game in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Street Wraith and Consider helps to dig deeper into the deck for key pieces needed to execute the combo efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to lock down the opponent's resources through a combination of artifacts and control elements. By utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator, Trinisphere, and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from playing key cards. Additionally, the deck relies on powerful artifact threats like Ugin, the Eye of the Storms and The One Ring to control the board and secure victory. This deck excels at setting up a prison-like environment for the opponent, making it difficult for them to mount a successful offense.

The primary strategy of this Bant Control deck is to effectively control the field through countering opponent's spells with Force of Negation and Force of Will, while also using Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. The deck aims to gain card advantage using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler, while also utilizing Leyline Binding for removal and protection. Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide additional threats on the board, and Up the Beanstalk offers ramp potential. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and consistency.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Coveted Jewel combo by utilizing cards such as Transmute Artifact, Grim Monolith, and Copy Artifact. It also includes multiple ways to protect the combo with Force of Will and a small Emrakul, the Aeons Torn package. The inclusion of Phyrexian Metamorph and Paradox Engine adds flexibility and redundancy to the combo. Show and Tell can be used to cheat out powerful threats like Emrakul, while cards like Urza's Saga and Cryogen Relic provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck's main win condition is either assembling the Coveted Jewel combo or hardcasting Emrakul to overpower the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game tempo by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and hand disruption, while deploying efficient threats to apply pressure. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast and aggressive pace with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Nethergoyf. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with threats. The mana base is designed to support the two-color deck while including powerful lands like Wasteland for additional disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It includes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, as well as cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Flow State help draw through the deck to find the combo pieces, while cards like Murktide Regent provide a backup win condition. Wasteland and Cavern of Souls help protect the combo from disruption, making it a powerful and resilient deck in the Legacy format.

The focus of this deck is to control the game by leveraging the synergy between lands and other cards to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain board advantage. Utilizing cards like Life from the Loam, Exploration, and Crop Rotation, the deck aims to generate value and delay opponents with cards like Maze of Ith and Ghost Quarter. The key win condition revolves around assembling the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo to create a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. Additionally, cards like Mox Diamond and Urza's Saga provide ramp and consistency for the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Sand Scout, supported by powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck also includes ways to protect and enhance its creatures with cards like Voice of Victory and Guide of Souls. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to control the opponent's board while maintaining aggression. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck.

The deck revolves around generating mana quickly and efficiently to cast multiple spells in a single turn, leading to a high storm count. It aims to use cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Dark Ritual to power out spells that generate more mana, before eventually casting Tendrils of Agony to finish off the opponent. The deck also has access to Burning Wish to find specific silver-bullet cards from the sideboard to help close out the game or protect the combo. It is designed to be fast, consistent, and able to win the game in one explosive turn.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive playstyle by utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, supported by powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Static Prison while disrupting opponents with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Wasteland. The inclusion of versatile lands like Plateau and Karakas allows for flexibility and consistency in gameplay, ensuring a strong emphasis on applying pressure and overwhelming opponents quickly.

The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early with aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Clarion Conqueror while disrupting their strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Archon of Emeria. It also has ways to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize, utilizing a mix of creature threats and disruptive spells to secure victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. With cards like Thoughtseize, Swords to Plowshares, and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the board while creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters deal damage quickly. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach and versatility. By combining efficient removal and powerful creatures, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with big creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting and Reanimate. Players can then use Animate Dead and Shallow Grave to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful early-game advantage. The deck also includes disruption elements like Unmask, Thoughtseize, and Cabal Therapy to hinder the opponent's game plan. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast reanimation of game-winning threats.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through ramping up mana with Cloudpost/Tron lands, while also utilizing powerful control cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to efficiently use its resources to play big threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Karn, the Great Creator to dominate the board. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Portent of Calamity and Sink into Stupor to slow down the opponent's strategy, allowing it to establish its own dominant board presence.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a combination of creature beatdown and disruptive spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Ocelot Pride and Amped Raptor, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, the deck utilizes sacrifice synergies with Goblin Bombardment and Cabal Therapy to remove threats and generate advantage. The mana base consists of land destruction elements like Wasteland and Karakas to disrupt the opponent's mana base while efficiently utilizing Mardu colors.
